parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the switch lever of the electrical switch, made of ABS plastic. It is the movable part that users press or flip to control the circuit.
parts.Functional_description: It functions as the actuator that opens or closes the electrical circuit when toggled.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots or rocks around a hinge or axis to change the electrical contact state.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or mounting plate of the switch, made of polycarbonate. It provides structural support and houses the internal electrical components.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the switch mechanism in place and provides insulation and mounting support for installation on walls or panels.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during operation.
